messages:
maria: quick heads-up — nightly incremental restore for tenant-73 failed integrity checks. restore-checker shows `decrypt_fail: no-kms-envelope` for 5 objects in s3://redwood-backups/2026-03-25/inc/

luke: ouch. can you share head-object for one of the parts?

maria: ran `aws s3api head-object --bucket redwood-backups --key 2026-03-25/inc/part-0041.tar.gz` output: `{ "ContentLength": 14567890, "Metadata": {} }` — metadata empty, no `x-amz-meta-kms-envelope`.

anya: did we change the uploader principal or role recently? i recall the backup-uploader was consolidated into `backup-operator` last week.

raj: yes — PR #4002 switched uploader to use kms-proxy generateDataKey grants instead of direct kms:Encrypt (rolled 2026-03-23).

sam (oncall): checked kms-proxy logs around 00:02 UTC: GenerateDataKey returned 200 but response body length=0 for tenant-73. uploader recorded `kms_wrap_ok` and proceeded to PUT without adding envelope metadata.

luke: so two issues: proxy returning empty payload, and uploader not validating presence of `CiphertextBlob` in response.

maria: immediate mitigation: prevent more untagged parts from being treated as valid backups. S3 policy can't assert arbitrary non-empty metadata. fastest path is an ObjectCreated Lambda that moves objects lacking `x-amz-meta-kms-envelope` into snapshot-quarantine and increments a metric.

anya: agree. i'll author a short runbook: quarantine -> run decrypt-dryrun -> tag affected snapshots -> escalate to encops/sec.

sam (oncall): deploying quarantine-lambda + CloudWatch alarm `MissingKmsEnvelopeParts`. will push to prod now.

deploy-bot: quarantine-lambda v1.2.0 deployed to prod (run-id: dpl-20260325-02) :white_check_mark:

raj: i'm opening rollback PR to revert the role consolidation for uploader in prod until we validate proxy behavior (PR #4010). staging already rolled back.

maria: post-incident checklist (short-term):
- uploader: require non-empty `CiphertextBlob` before proceeding; emit `encrypt_response_invalid` metric and abort upload
- add unit + integration test where proxy returns 0-byte body and uploader must fail-fast
- deploy ObjectCreated quarantine lambda and alert on >3 quarantined parts per hour
- scan backups window 00:00-00:30 for missing-envelope parts and move to quarantine

anya: long-term: stop relying on uploader-set metadata as the only integrity proof. add top-level encrypted manifest containing per-part KMS envelopes and SHA256 checksums; require manifest validation at restore time.

luke: also add a KMS-audit query: list GenerateDataKey events with principal != uploader svcacct or with anomalous response sizes; surface daily anomalous events report to /reports/encops.

sam (oncall): quarantine run discovered 13 parts across 4 tenants in the same minute-range. moving them to s3://backup-quarantine/2026-03-25/ and kicking off decrypt-dryrun — none decryptable as expected.

maria: escalating to sec-team: @sec-team this affects restore integrity for multiple tenants. no signs of exfil but recommend severity=S2 and full tenant scan.

sec-team: acknowledged. creating incident INC-2026-130 and assigning to encops + eng-security.

anya: assigning owners:
- anya: encops lead, runbook update, account owner notifications
- raj: proxy deeper triage and telemetry patch (marshal timeout handling)
- luke: uploader validation + CI test patch
- sam: quarantine tuning, scan completion, restore re-checks

maria: additional follow-ups: add a nightly random restore (sample 1%) job to catch silent metadata failures; and add SLO that flags more than 0 silently-failing restores in a week.

luke: noted. i'll draft the encrypted manifest RFC and push a design doc.

maria: reconvene in 40m after full scan completes.
